exec_cmd.description: The full command line to invoke the notification daemon, including any required arguments.

hidden.description: Whether to hide the service from the application menu. Set to true for debugging or testing.

startup_delay.description: Optional delay in milliseconds before starting the daemon after session initialization. Use for service dependency ordering.

env_vars.description: List of environment variable assignments (e.g., 'DISPLAY=:0') to be set before launching the daemon.

items.description: A single environment variable in KEY=value format.

icon.description: Icon name or path to associate with the notification daemon (e.g., 'dialog-information' or '/usr/share/icons/hicolor/48x48/apps/notify-osd.png'). Optional.
